hints.title: Bounded Sample Domain
hints.text: The values only range from 0 to 255. A single pass over the counts provides total count, sum, minimum, maximum, and modal value.

hints.title: Cumulative Count for Median
hints.text: Determine the positions of the middle element or two middle elements. A second cumulative pass pinpoints exactly which integer values correspond to those ranks.

hints.title: Median Average
hints.text: Target indices are (total + 1) // 2 and (total + 2) // 2. Average the two matching values to obtain the float median.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def sampleStats(self, count: list[int]) -> list[float]:
        total = sum(count)
        min_val = -1.0
        max_val = -1.0
        sum_val = 0
        mode_val = 0.0
        max_freq = 0
        
        for i, c in enumerate(count):
            if c > 0:
                if min_val == -1.0:
                    min_val = float(i)
                max_val = float(i)
                sum_val += i * c
                if c > max_freq:
                    max_freq = c
                    mode_val = float(i)
        
        mean_val = sum_val / total
        target1 = (total + 1) // 2
        target2 = (total + 2) // 2
        med1, med2 = None, None
        cur = 0
        for i, c in enumerate(count):
            cur += c
            if med1 is None and cur >= target1:
                med1 = i
            if med2 is None and cur >= target2:
                med2 = i
                break
        median_val = (med1 + med2) / 2.0
        return [min_val, max_val, mean_val, median_val, mode_val]
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding the frequencies into an array wastes gigabytes of memory when count sum approaches 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Processing the 256-bucket frequency array directly guarantees O(1) space and time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle cumulative indexing for even and odd totals without allocating an array.
complexity.notes: All 5 sample statistics can be derived directly from the frequency buckets.
